Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the time today. Appreciate you walking us through the triage workflow and the main pain: inconsistent extraction quality for clinical intake notes and the high cost of current manual review. Per our call, I sketched a compact POC that lets your team validate performance against a small, high-impact slice of traffic without requiring full integration up front.

High-level proposal (1–3 week focused pilot):
- Scope: ~2k clinical intake notes (historical subset) covering 3 intake forms (ER triage, referral, outpatient intake).
- Goal: automated extraction precision >= 88% on the primary fields (patient name, DOB, chief complaint) and end-to-end reduction of manual review time by 40% for this slice.
- Evaluation: 200 holdout notes, blinded review by Artera clinical ops; precision/recall breakdown + sample error analysis.
- Deliverables: hosted inference endpoint, export of model output (CSV), short error log with representative failure cases.

Proposed timeline and owners
- Week 0 (prep): data selection & export (Artera) — owner: Rachel / Artera data ops
- Week 1 (ingest & baseline run): Redwood will ingest export, run baseline model, and deliver initial outputs — owner: Ben (Redwood)
- Week 2 (analysis & tuning): joint review session, small prompt/model tweaks; Redwood provides tuned checkpoint and updated outputs — owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Rachel
- Week 3 (validation & acceptance): holdout evaluation and final acceptance meeting — owner: Rachel + Artera clinical reviewer

Immediate asks from Artera (to unblock kickoff):
1) A secure export (S3 link or secure Drive) of ~2k de-identified intake notes and schema mapping for the three forms.
2) Point of contact for data transfer and an estimated date the export will be available.
3) Any internal success criteria beyond precision/time savings (e.g., required coverage on certain fields).

Compliance & security notes:
- We will provide an upload checklist and a short guide on acceptable de-identification steps.
- If you prefer, we can run the initial baseline on a synthetic subset first.

Attachments: POC_Timeline_v1.xlsx (proposed schedule), short checklist stub embedded below.

Looking forward to your thoughts — if this aligns I can circulate a one-page mutual action plan and proposed MSA addendum for the short pilot.

Best,
Ben
